description: Corrected commercial account: metric and causality withdrawn, a contradiction to clarify and refusal without psychological interpretation.

echanges.question: Tell me about the last time someone chose you.
echanges.reponse: A shop chose me to rewrite its offer page. I often say I doubled its sales through my copy.

echanges.question: What supports that result?
echanges.reponse: I need to correct what I just said: I confused sales with visits. The owner told me visits doubled during a promotion. I have neither baseline figures nor access to the analytics.

echanges.question: What did you do personally?
echanges.reponse: I rewrote the headings and reordered the arguments. The owner launched the promotion at the same time. I withdraw the claim that my copy caused the increase: I cannot isolate its effect.

echanges.question: How do you usually describe your working method?
echanges.reponse: I say I never accept a project without speaking directly to the shop’s customers.

echanges.question: How did this project unfold?
echanges.reponse: Actually, on this project I spoke to no customer. I worked from the owner’s explanations. There is an exception to my usual description; I need to rephrase it.

echanges.question: What record would describe your work?
echanges.reponse: I have the before and after versions of the headings. They show what I changed, not an increase in sales. I do not want to name the shop or discuss it further.

echanges.question: What limit must stay in your introduction?
echanges.reponse: I want to say I clarify a page’s arguments using the available information. I do not guarantee higher sales and no longer want to say I always interview customers.

echanges.question: What next step would suit you?
echanges.reponse: I can compare my introduction with what my two versions show and note one unanswered question. I would rather do this on my own for now and publish nothing.

faits_a_conserver: The initial doubled-sales claim is withdrawn; only doubled visits are reported by the owner, without baseline figures or analytics.
A simultaneous promotion prevents isolating the copy’s effect.
The rule about always speaking to customers has an acknowledged exception; the wording is corrected.
Before/after headings are described, not provided; confidentiality and private work are requested.
affirmations_interdites: Doubled sales or commercial causality attributed to the copy.
Correction treated as lying, denial, sabotage or hidden fear.
Refusal to name the shop interpreted as avoidance or an admitted omission.
Absolute customer-interview rule retained after correction.
criteres: The four axes assess only support in the account, without an average, personal worth score or inferred market demand.
Confidence expresses interpretive uncertainty, not a scientific probability.
Evidence quotes exactly one answer and its existing turn; no described record is presented as verified by Atlas.
heritage is null and evitements stays empty: none of these scenarios reports a deliberate omission.
The bio is a proposed professional statement bounded by the facts, never a definitive identity.
There is one reversible, observable next step feasible within 48 hours; suggested pistes are optional, at most three.
For an interview follow-up: one open question of at most ten words; corrections are applied and boundaries respected.
Proposing a comparison does not establish that no comparison has already happened.
The effect of the copy is unknown, not established as zero; the criterion accepts zero changes supporting the introduction.

Every public assertion preserves the established author, episode, quantity and timing, including next-step reasons, intersections and suggested directions. Before/after headings are not presented as the only records held; the owner is not presented as the only interlocutor.
No elapsed time between the project and the interview is known: do not invent months passing.
Factual premises of hypotheses also respect corrections: the sales and causality claim concerned this episode and was corrected, so not every episode-level statement held up without correction.
The account applies corrections without narrating the repair of the Card, without observation identifiers in prose and without doubled qualification prefixes.
